clauses.title: Every batch-sequence guard failure names its violated condition
requires: naming the violated condition and the observed value — the specific subcheck, not the guard as a whole
A guard failure with no named condition, such as a bare nonzero exit with no output, is not evidence that a boundary was violated
a true failure after editing begins remains terminal with no retry and no guard substitution (CL-D39), and an implementation-defect stop is terminal the same way

clauses.title: Naming-duty fixtures pin the rule and the record
requires: every batch-sequence guard failure names its violated condition
CL-D55 records the naming duty and what it deliberately does not change
